dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep, concave falcate curvature that follows a smooth spline from the posterior insertion point to the sub-terminal apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is classified as rounded with a wide pixel radius, lacking any acute or jagged termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a continuous convex arc with a mean angular steepness of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible base width of the fin is roughly equal to its maximum vertical height, yielding an approximate 1:1 pixel aspect ratio.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, light-colored punctate marks and faint linear striations are visible across the lateral torso and the central surface of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The skin surface displays high specular reflectance with prominent micro-texturing from adhering water droplets and surface tension ripples.
